summary: @servicetitan/kendo-theme ships a preinstall Bun-runtime dropper executing an obfuscated payload
details: Package is published as a Kendo CSS theme (main is dist/index.css) but declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is obfuscated with _0x-style identifiers and per-call string maps; on install it downloads the Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmod +x's the Bun binary, and invokes it via execFileSync against a sibling math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB Bun-cjs bundle beginning '// @bun @bun-cjs' followed by an obfuscator.io-style numeric/string constant array with a decoder function, with no relation to a CSS theme. The alternate-runtime step executes the obfuscated payload under Bun so Node-focused install-time analysis does not observe it. Package.json has empty description, no repository, and no homepage, and uses the @servicetitan scope with no evident affiliation to ServiceTitan Inc., only a devDependency on @progress/kendo-theme-default.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
